markdown.markdownText:
### 📦 product-catalog
**Team** Catalog · **On-call** `#oncall-catalog` · **Tier** high · **Go** gRPC

| ⬅️ Called by | ➡️ Calls |
|---|---|
| 🖥️ **frontend** · GetProduct, ListProducts | 🐘 **astronomy-db** · PostgreSQL |
| 🧾 **checkout** · GetProduct | 🚩 **flagd** · productCatalogFailure |
| ✨ **recommendation** · ListProducts | |

metrics.promqlQuery: sum by (method) (label_replace((sum by (span_name) (increase(calls_total{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"oteldemo[.]ProductCatalogService/.+", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[${__range}])) or 0 * sum by (span_name) (increase(calls_total{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"oteldemo[.]ProductCatalogService/.+"}[${__range}]))) / sum by (span_name) (increase(calls_total{service_name="product-catalog", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name=~"oteldemo[.]ProductCatalogService/.+"}[${__range}])), "method", "$1", "span_name", "oteldemo[.]ProductCatalogService/(.+)"))

widgets.title: Failed calls seen by callers (per s)

metrics.promqlQuery: sum by (service_name, method) (label_replace(sum by (service_name, span_name) (rate(calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name=~"oteldemo[.]ProductCatalogService/.+", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])), "method", "$1", "span_name", "oteldemo[.]ProductCatalogService/(.+)")) > 0

widgets.title: Errors by method, gRPC status and product
widgets.description: From error spans, which tail sampling keeps in full. INTERNAL on one product = productCatalogFailure flag; NOT_FOUND across products = the database didn't answer.

dataprime.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'product-catalog' && $d.tags['span.kind'] == 'server' && $d.tags['otel.status_code'] == 'ERROR' | groupby substr($l.operationName, 31, 40) as method, $d.tags['rpc.response.status_code']:string as grpc_status, $d.tags['demo.product.id']:string as product_id aggregate count() as errors | orderby errors desc

options.name: 🛒 Shopper impact: edge and browser
options.description: What the catalog's health means for people browsing: the /api/products routes at the proxy, and product pages in real browsers (RUM).

dataprime.query: source rum.events | filter $l.applicationName == 'Web-Client' && $d.event_context.type == 'network-request' && $d.network_request_context.fragments:string.startsWith('api/products') | aggregate percentile(0.75, $d.network_request_context.duration:number) as p75

source rum.events | filter $l.applicationName == 'Web-Client' && $d.event_context.type == 'web-vitals' && $d.web_vitals_context.name == 'LCP' && $d.page_context.page_fragments:string == 'product/{productId}' | aggregate percentile(0.75, $d.web_vitals_context.value:number) as lcp_p75

widgets.title: Edge responses/s by route and status

dataprime.query: source rum.events | filter $l.applicationName == 'Web-Client' && $d.event_context.type == 'network-request' && $d.network_request_context.fragments:string.startsWith('api/products') | groupby roundTime($m.timestamp, 5m) as timestamp, $d.network_request_context.fragments:string as path aggregate percentile(0.75, $d.network_request_context.duration:number) as p75

widgets.title: DB errors by type (per s)
widgets.description: ErrBadConn = the pool handed out a dead connection (astronomy-db restarted); net.OpError = couldn't connect at all

widgets.title: Connection pool
widgets.description: Pool size is unlimited (max_open 0). Waits mean every connection was busy.

widgets.title: Restarts (per 10 min)
widgets.description: astronomy-db has been OOMKilled repeatedly; each restart shows up as DB errors above.

widgets.title: Go memory vs GOMEMLIMIT
widgets.description: When used memory sits at GOMEMLIMIT the GC runs constantly and CPU goes to collection instead of requests.

options.name: ☸️ Kubernetes and logs
options.description: Pod resources for the service and its database, and what the service is logging.

dataprime.query: source logs | filter $l.subsystemName == 'product-catalog' | groupby roundTime($m.timestamp, 1m) as timestamp, $m.severity:string as severity aggregate count() as logs

source logs | filter $l.subsystemName == 'product-catalog' && ($m.severity == WARNING || $m.severity == ERROR || $m.severity == CRITICAL) | orderby $m.timestamp desc | limit 50 | choose formatTimestamp($m.timestamp:timestamp, '%H:%M:%S') as time_utc, $m.severity:string as severity, $d.message as message, $d.attributes['exception.message'] as exception
